normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with an empty lot behind a fence and end with a news bulletin about a case.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从围挡后面的一块空地开始，落到一条关于案件的消息。

normal.en: Development is the noun for whatever has been unfolding.
normal.cn: development 就是那个「一直在展开的东西」的名词。

normal.en: Scaffolding is a promise written in metal.
normal.cn: 脚手架是用金属写下的承诺。

normal.en: A district and a child both change without a single loud moment.
normal.cn: 一片街区和一个小孩子，都是在没有响亮瞬间的情况下改变的。

normal.en: News arrives in pieces; so do buildings.
normal.cn: 消息一块块地来，楼房也是。

normal.en: The old harbour kept its shape while its meaning changed.
normal.cn: 老港区形状没变，含义却变了。

abstract.en: Picture a crane turning slowly above a fence.
abstract.cn: 想象一台塔吊在围挡上方慢慢转动。

abstract.en: Picture a map with one new road added each year.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图，每年多出一条新路。

abstract.en: Picture a stack of papers, each one a fresh update.
abstract.cn: 想象一叠文件，每一份都是新的进展。

examples.en: Economic development changed the whole region.
examples.cn: 经济发展改变了整个地区。

examples.en: The development of the old harbour took five years.
examples.cn: 老港区的开发花了五年。

examples.en: We are waiting for the latest development in the case.
examples.cn: 我们在等这个案件的最新进展。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 development 记成「地维勒普门特」：de 是打开，velop 是包裹，-ment 是名词尾巴，打开包裹的过程就是发展与开发。

root: 来自法语 developpement，词根 developper 意为打开包裹，十八世纪进入英语。从「展开」引申为事物逐步成长的过程，再用于经济与生物学的成长，也指土地开发以及局势的新进展。

sensesIntro.en: From a process unfolding over years, to land turned into buildings, to one new piece of news.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一年年展开的过程，到土地变成楼房，再到一条新的消息。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: scaffolding rising floor by floor above an empty lot.
core.cn: 核心意象：脚手架在一块空地上方一层层升高。

branches.en: The first sense is the whole slow direction of change.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是整个缓慢的变化方向。

branches.en: The second sense is that direction made of concrete and steel.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是那个方向被混凝土和钢变成实物。

branches.en: The third sense is one new floor of a story.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是一个故事新长出来的一层。

branches.en: A region grows and a site is built by the same forward motion.
branches.cn: 地区的成长与场地的建设，靠的是同一种向前的运动。

branches.en: Both a process and a piece of news leave the old state behind.
branches.cn: 过程与消息，都把旧状态留在了身后。

intro.en: Development has a family built on unwrapping and on things slowly taking shape.
intro.cn: development 有一族词，建在「打开包裹」与「慢慢成形」之上。

latinIntro.en: The French base means to unwrap, and -ment turns the action into a process or a result.
latinIntro.cn: 它的法语词基意为打开包裹，后缀 -ment 把动作变成过程或结果。

items.meaning: not yet used or built on

items.exampleCN: 重新开发明年春天开始。

definition_en: a machine or tool made for a particular purpose
core_image: 桌上一个拆开的小机器，线圈和齿轮裸露在外
scene: 他拧开外壳，里面的线圈和齿轮露出来，桌上散着小螺丝。The device measures the moisture in the soil.
sceneCN: 这里 device 指「装置」（第 1 个义项：为特定用途做的小机器）；句意是这个装置测量土壤里的湿度。

senses.title: A piece of equipment
senses.definition: a machine or tool made for a particular job
senses.definitionCN: 为某项特定工作而制造的机器或工具
senses.example: The device measures the moisture in the soil.
senses.exampleCN: 这个装置测量土壤里的湿度。
senses.why: Human hands cannot stay in the field all year, so a small machine does.
senses.whyCN: 人的手没法整年守在田里，于是让一台小机器守着。

senses.title: A method or trick
senses.definition: a plan or trick used to get a particular result
senses.definitionCN: 为得到某个结果而用的计策或花招
senses.example: Silence was just a device to make us talk.
senses.exampleCN: 沉默只是一种让我们开口的手段。
senses.why: A plan can work like a tool even when it has no parts.
senses.whyCN: 一个计策即使没有零件，也能像工具那样起作用。

senses.title: A literary technique
senses.definition: a particular way of writing that produces a chosen effect
senses.definitionCN: 为产生某种效果而采用的特定写法
senses.example: The writer uses repetition as a poetic device.
senses.exampleCN: 这位作家把重复当作一种诗歌手法。
senses.why: Words can be arranged as carefully as gears.
senses.whyCN: 词语也能像齿轮那样被仔细排布。

intro.en: Device comes from Old French devis, a plan or division, which grew from Latin dividere, to divide, and it split from the verb devise.
intro.cn: device 来自古法语 devis（计划、划分），源头是拉丁语 dividere（分开），后来与动词 devise 分了家。

items.en: Dividere meant to divide or separate a whole into parts.
items.cn: dividere 指把一个整体分开、切成几部分。

items.en: Devis named a plan, a division of work or a design.
items.cn: devis 指一份计划、一种分工或一个设计。

items.en: English device first meant a plan or a heraldic design.
items.cn: 英语 device 最初指计划或纹章图案。

items.en: The sense shifted from the plan to the thing built from it.
items.cn: 词义从计划本身转到了照计划造出来的东西。

items.en: It now means any small machine, and also a trick or a method.
items.cn: 如今它指任何小型机器，也指花招或方法。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the vis shape, while the meaning group names useful objects and tools.
note.cn: 形近组共用 vis 这一段，近义组则给出有用的小物件与工具。

entries.definition: to invent a plan or a method
not direct or honest
an opinion about what someone should do
entries.definitionCN: 关于某人该怎么做的一种意见

entries.definition: a small useful machine
a tool used for careful work
an object held to do a job

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a cracked-open casing on a table and end with a writer counting repeated words.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从桌上一个撬开的外壳开始，落到一位反复数词的作家。

normal.en: A device begins as a devis, a plan drawn before any part exists.
normal.cn: device 起初只是一个 devis，一张还没有零件时就画好的图。

normal.en: Take one letter away and the noun becomes the verb devise.
normal.cn: 拿掉一个字母，名词就变成动词 devise。

normal.en: Anything with a switch can be called a device today.
normal.cn: 今天任何带开关的东西都能叫 device。

normal.en: Silence can be a device too, with no wires at all.
normal.cn: 沉默也能是一种手段，一根线都不用。

normal.en: A repeated phrase is a device the ear remembers.
normal.cn: 重复的句子是一种耳朵记得住的手法。

abstract.en: Picture a screwdriver beside four loose screws.
abstract.cn: 想象一把螺丝刀旁边放着四颗松开的螺丝。

abstract.en: Picture a blue light blinking on a small plastic box.
abstract.cn: 想象一个小塑料盒上闪着蓝灯。

abstract.en: Picture the same word printed five times down a page.
abstract.cn: 想象同一个词在纸上竖着印了五遍。

examples.en: The device measures the moisture in the soil.
examples.cn: 这个装置测量土壤里的湿度。

examples.en: Silence was just a device to make us talk.
examples.cn: 沉默只是一种让我们开口的手段。

examples.en: The writer uses repetition as a poetic device.
examples.cn: 这位作家把重复当作一种诗歌手法。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 device 记成「地歪死」：de 是分开，vis 是看，把东西分开来看，看清结构再装成一件装置。

root: 来自古法语 devis（计划、划分），源头是拉丁语 dividere（分开），与动词 devise 同源后在英语中分化。本义是计划或设计，十六世纪起转指照设计造出的物件，再引申为手段与文学手法。

sensesIntro.en: From a plan drawn on paper, to the machine built from it, to a trick or a turn of style.
sensesIntro.cn: 从画在纸上的计划，到照它造出的机器，再到一个花招或一种笔法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small machine opened on a table, its parts laid bare.
core.cn: 核心意象：一台小机器在桌上被拆开，零件都露在外面。

branches.en: The first sense is the plan turned into hardware.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是计划变成了硬件。

branches.en: The second sense is a plan that needs no parts at all.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是根本不需要零件的计划。

branches.en: The third sense is a plan made of words.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是用词语做成的计划。

branches.en: A machine and a trick both exist to get a result.
branches.cn: 机器与花招，都是为得到一个结果而存在。

branches.en: A trick and a literary device both shape how you respond.
branches.cn: 花招与文学手法，都在塑造你的反应。

intro.en: Device belongs to a family about planning, dividing and building something useful.
intro.cn: device 属于一族词，围绕计划、划分与造出有用的东西。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base dividere means to divide, and the French plan word devis grew from it.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基 dividere 意为分开，法语里表示计划的 devis 就是从它长出来的。

items.meaning: a thing made from a plan
more than one piece of equipment
to invent a plan or method
items.exampleCN: 他们设计了一个简单的测试。
这个游戏设计得很巧妙。

items.example: Devising the rules took a week.
The deviser of the game is unknown.
items.exampleCN: 这个游戏的设计者不详。

items.example: He took a devious route home.
items.exampleCN: 他绕了一条弯路上回家。

definition_en: the most powerful evil spirit, or a wicked or mischievous person
core_image: 炉火猛地一亮，墙上投下一具带角的影子
scene: 老人指着壁画上那个长角的影子，讲起村里流传很久的传说。The old story says the devil lives under the bridge.
sceneCN: 这里 devil 指「魔鬼」（第 1 个义项：传说中邪恶的精灵）；句意是那个古老的故事说魔鬼住在桥下。

senses.title: The great evil spirit
senses.definition: the most powerful evil spirit in many religions
senses.definitionCN: 许多宗教中力量最强的邪恶精灵
senses.example: The old story says the devil lives under the bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 那个古老的故事说魔鬼住在桥下。
senses.why: A village needs one face to put on everything it fears.
senses.whyCN: 一个村子需要一张脸，用来安放它所有的恐惧。

senses.title: A wicked or sorry person
senses.definition: a cruel person, or a person in a very sorry state
senses.definitionCN: 残忍的人，或处境极为可怜的人
senses.example: The poor devil had lost his home and his job.
senses.exampleCN: 那个可怜的家伙失去了房子和工作。
senses.why: The heaviest word in the room gets borrowed for plain misery.
senses.whyCN: 屋里最重的那个词，常被借来说寻常的苦。

senses.title: A mischievous child
senses.definition: a child who behaves in a playful and slightly annoying way
senses.definitionCN: 行为顽皮、有点让人头疼的孩子
senses.example: You little devil, you hid my keys again.

intro.en: Devil comes from Greek diabolos, a slanderer, through Latin diabolus and Old English deofol.
intro.cn: devil 来自希腊语 diabolos（诽谤者），经拉丁语 diabolus 与古英语 deofol 进入英语。

items.en: Diabolos meant a slanderer, one who throws words across to divide people.
items.cn: diabolos 指诽谤者，即把话扔过去让人分裂的人。

items.en: Latin diabolus took the word over as the name of the chief evil spirit.
items.cn: 拉丁语 diabolus 接过这个词，用作首要恶灵的名字。

items.en: Deofol entered English with Christian teaching.
items.cn: deofol 随基督教教义进入英语。

items.en: The word spread into curses, proverbs and everyday scolding.
items.cn: 这个词扩展进咒骂、谚语与日常责骂里。

items.en: It now also teases a naughty child or pities a poor man.
items.cn: 如今它也用来打趣淘气的孩子，或同情可怜的人。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the devil stem or sound, and the meaning group names evil spirits.
note.cn: 形近组共用 devil 的词干或读音，近义组则指各种邪恶精灵。

entries.definition: very bad or harmful
like a devil, or very difficult
wicked behaviour or magic
an evil spirit
a very cruel person
the chief evil spirit in the Bible

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a horned shadow on a wall and end with a child laughing behind a curtain.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从墙上带角的影子开始，落到帘子后面偷笑的孩子。

normal.en: The Greek word meant slanderer, so the devil began as a whisperer.
normal.cn: 那个希腊词意为诽谤者，所以魔鬼最初是个说悄悄话的人。

normal.en: One word carries both the terror and the teasing.
normal.cn: 同一个词，既装着恐惧，也装着打趣。

normal.en: A poor devil is a man whose luck has run out.
normal.cn: a poor devil 就是运气用光了的男人。

normal.en: The devil in a story always arrives with a bargain.
normal.cn: 故事里的魔鬼，总是带着一桩交易上场。

normal.en: Small horns on a child are only a costume.
normal.cn: 孩子头上的小角，不过是一套装扮。

abstract.en: Picture a shadow with two pointed horns.
abstract.cn: 想象一个带两只尖角的影子。

abstract.en: Picture a hand offering a contract across a table.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手隔着桌子递来一份契约。

abstract.en: Picture keys hidden under a cushion.
abstract.cn: 想象钥匙被藏在坐垫下面。

examples.en: The old story says the devil lives under the bridge.
examples.cn: 那个古老的故事说魔鬼住在桥下。

examples.en: The poor devil had lost his home and his job.
examples.cn: 那个可怜的家伙失去了房子和工作。

examples.en: You little devil, you hid my keys again.
examples.cn: 你这个小淘气，又把我的钥匙藏起来了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 devil 记成「得我」：de 是向下，vil 像「歪」，心思一路向下歪，就成了魔鬼。

root: 来自希腊语 diabolos（诽谤者、挑拨者），经拉丁语 diabolus 与古英语 deofol 进入英语。本义是宗教中的首要恶灵，后来用于骂人、表示恶棍，也用来打趣淘气的孩子或同情处境可怜的人。

sensesIntro.en: From a spirit that whispers division, to a man whose luck has failed, to a small child with a grin.
sensesIntro.cn: 从低声挑拨的灵，到运气耗尽的人，再到咧嘴笑的小孩。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a horned shadow thrown on a wall by firelight.
core.cn: 核心意象：火光在墙上投下一个带角的影子。

branches.en: The first sense is the shadow that religion gave a name.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是宗教给了名字的那个影子。

branches.en: The second sense turns that name onto a man who suffers.
branches.cn: 第二个义项把这个名字转到受苦的人身上。

branches.en: The third sense shrinks the horns to toy size.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把角缩成了玩具大小。

branches.en: The great evil and an ordinary wretch share one word.
branches.cn: 大恶与寻常可怜人，共用一个词。

branches.en: Terror and fondness can sit in the same syllable.
branches.cn: 恐惧与疼爱，能坐在同一个音节里。

intro.en: Devil has a family of adjectives and nouns built on the same old image.
intro.cn: devil 有一族形容词与名词，建在同一个古老画面上。

latinIntro.en: The Greek base means slanderer, and the family keeps both the evil and the playful tone.
latinIntro.cn: 它的希腊词基意为诽谤者，这一族词同时保留邪恶与顽皮两种口气。

items.example: The devil appears in many tales.
items.exampleCN: 魔鬼出现在许多故事里。

items.example: The play is full of devils.
The boys were full of devilment.

items.exampleCN: 村民们把这事归咎于邪术。

items.example: There was devilishness in his eyes.

items.exampleCN: 延误一直困扰着这个项目。

definition_en: a simple drawing that shows the parts of something or how it works
core_image: 黑板上几个方框和箭头，把机器的内部讲清楚
scene: 老师在黑板上画了几个方框和箭头，把水流的方向标出来。The diagram shows how water moves through the plant.
sceneCN: 这里 diagram 指「示意图」（第 1 个义项：用简单线条说明结构的图）；句意是这张示意图显示水如何在植物中流动。

senses.title: A simple explanatory drawing
senses.definition: a simple drawing that shows the parts of something and how they fit
senses.definitionCN: 用简单线条画出某物的各部分及其组合关系
senses.example: The diagram shows how water moves through the plant.
senses.exampleCN: 这张示意图显示水如何在植物中流动。
senses.why: A picture of the parts removes the need for a hundred words.
senses.whyCN: 一张画清零件的图，省掉了一百句话。

senses.title: A chart of steps or numbers
senses.definition: a drawing that sets out numbers, steps or relations in visual form
senses.definitionCN: 把数字、步骤或关系用视觉形式摆出来的图
senses.example: The diagram on page ten compares the two methods.
senses.exampleCN: 第十页上的图表比较了这两种方法。
senses.why: Once the steps are drawn, the eye can walk them.
senses.whyCN: 步骤一旦被画出来，眼睛就能在上面走。

senses.title: Show something by drawing
senses.definition: to represent something with a simple drawing
senses.definitionCN: 用简单的图把某事物表示出来
senses.example: He diagrammed the route on the back of an envelope.
senses.exampleCN: 他在信封背面把路线画了出来。
senses.why: When speech fails, the hand reaches for a pen.
senses.whyCN: 说不清的时候，手就去拿笔。

intro.en: Diagram comes from Greek diagramma, something marked out by lines, built from dia- and graphein, to write or draw.
intro.cn: diagram 来自希腊语 diagramma（用线标出来的东西），由 dia- 与 graphein（写、画）构成。

items.en: Graphein meant to scratch or draw, and diagramma meant a figure marked out.
items.cn: graphein 指刻画，diagramma 指被线条标出的图形。

items.en: Geometers used it for the figure drawn beside a proof.
items.cn: 几何学家用它指证明旁边画出的那个图形。

items.en: Latin diagramma kept the mathematical sense of a drawn figure.
items.cn: 拉丁语 diagramma 保留了画出图形的数学义。

items.en: English diagram named a figure used to explain a text.
items.cn: 英语 diagram 指用来解释文字的图形。

items.en: It now covers circuit plans, flow charts and simple sketches.
items.cn: 如今它覆盖电路图、流程图以及简单草图。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the dia- opening, while the meaning group names other visual aids.
note.cn: 形近组共用 dia- 开头，近义组则指其他几种视觉工具。

a line across a circle through its centre
entries.definitionCN: 穿过圆心横跨圆的一条线

entries.definition: a form of a language spoken in one area
entries.definitionCN: 某一地区所说的一种语言形式

a drawing of values on axes

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with chalk boxes on a blackboard and end with a route drawn on an envelope.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从黑板上的粉笔方框开始，落到画在信封上的路线。

normal.en: Dia- is through, and a diagram draws a line through a complicated thing.
normal.cn: dia- 是穿过，diagram 就是在一个复杂东西上画穿一条线。

normal.en: Boxes and arrows are a sentence the eye can read at once.
normal.cn: 方框与箭头，是一句眼睛一眼就能读完的话。

normal.en: A good diagram leaves out more than it shows.
normal.cn: 好的示意图，省掉的东西比画出来的多。

normal.en: The circuit and the river use the same little arrows.
normal.cn: 电路与河流，用的是同样的小箭头。

normal.en: When words get heavy, draw the shape.
normal.cn: 话变重的时候，就把形状画出来。

abstract.en: Picture three chalk squares joined by one line.
abstract.cn: 想象三个粉笔方框被一条线连起来。

abstract.en: Picture an arrow pointing down a narrow pipe.
abstract.cn: 想象一个箭头沿着一根细管向下指。

abstract.en: Picture a pen making a quick turn on paper.
abstract.cn: 想象一支笔在纸上快速拐了个弯。

examples.en: The diagram shows how water moves through the plant.
examples.cn: 这张示意图显示水如何在植物中流动。

examples.en: The diagram on page ten compares the two methods.
examples.cn: 第十页上的图表比较了这两种方法。

examples.en: He diagrammed the route on the back of an envelope.
examples.cn: 他在信封背面把路线画了出来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 diagram 记成「带个弯」：dia 是穿过，gram 是写下的东西，用线穿过复杂处写下来，就是示意图。

root: 来自希腊语 diagramma，由 dia-（穿过）与 graphein（刻画）组成，本义是用线标出的图形。经拉丁语进入英语，最初用于几何证明旁画的图，后来泛指解释结构、步骤与数据的各种图示。

sensesIntro.en: From a figure drawn beside a proof, to a chart of steps, to a quick sketch on an envelope.
sensesIntro.cn: 从证明旁边画出的图形，到步骤图表，再到信封上的快速草图。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a few boxes and arrows explaining a hidden mechanism.
core.cn: 核心意象：几个方框和箭头，把藏在里面的机关讲明白。

branches.en: The first sense is the parts laid out in space.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是把各部分在空间里摆开。

branches.en: The second sense puts steps and numbers in place of parts.
branches.cn: 第二个义项用步骤和数字替换了零件。

branches.en: The third sense is the act of drawing it at all.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是把它画出来这个动作本身。

branches.en: A machine and a set of figures are both made readable by lines.
branches.cn: 机器与一串数字，都靠线条变得可读。

branches.en: The chart and the quick sketch differ only in care.
branches.cn: 图表与速写，只差在精细程度。

intro.en: Diagram has a family built on drawing and on lines that mark a shape.
intro.cn: diagram 有一族词，建在「画」与「用线标出形状」之上。

latinIntro.en: The Greek base graphein means to draw or write, and dia- adds the sense of marking across.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊词基 graphein 意为画或写，前缀 dia- 添上横着标出的意思。

items.example: The diagram is easy to follow.
items.exampleCN: 这张示意图很容易看懂。
这本书有清楚的示意图。

items.meaning: the act of drawing a figure
items.example: Diagramming the flow took an hour.
items.exampleCN: 把流程画成图花了一小时。

items.meaning: in the form of a diagram
items.exampleCN: 这份平面图只是示意性的。
这些部件以图解方式呈现。
绘图的人用了三种颜色。
